name: Post-Matric National Merit Scholarship for Higher Education
description: Financial assistance for meritorious undergraduate and postgraduate students from economically disadvantaged families to pursue higher professional studies.
objective: To provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education.
eligibility: Class 12 / Diploma passed with minimum 75% marks. Family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum + Tuition Fee waiver up to ₹25,000
requiredDocuments: Verified Income from Revenue Dept (via MahaSetu)

name: State STEM Excellence Scholarship for Engineering & Technology
description: Special government scholarship for students enrolled in accredited Engineering, Polytechnic, and Technology degree programs across recognized state institutions.
objective: To encourage talent in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) domains.
eligibility: Minimum 65% aggregate in qualifying examination with Physics/Maths/Chemistry. Family annual income below ₹3,00,000.
benefits: ₹60,000 per annum towards academic & laboratory fees

name: Pragati Girl Child Technical Scholarship Scheme
description: Empowering young women pursuing degree and diploma level technical education in AICTE approved institutions.
objective: To support the advancement of girls pursuing technical education as a pathway to economic independence.
eligibility: Only female students admitted in 1st year of Degree/Diploma. Family income below ₹3,50,000 per annum.

name: Minority Community Higher Education Support Grant
description: Support grant for students belonging to notified minority communities studying in recognized universities.
objective: To augment opportunities for higher education among notified minority groups.
eligibility: Minimum 50% marks in previous final exam. Annual family income below ₹2,00,000.

name: Divyangjan Special Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities
description: Comprehensive financial support for differently-abled students pursuing professional, technical, or general degree courses.
objective: To ensure equal academic opportunities and assist with accessibility and study aids.
eligibility: Disability percentage 40% or above. Minimum 45% in previous examination. Income limit ₹4,00,000.
